Home/Replacement parts/Roborock S8 Pro Ultra

Roborock S8 Pro Ultra replacement parts.

For the U.S. Roborock S8 Pro Ultra bundle: S8 Pro Ultra robot model S81USP and Empty Wash Fill Dock models EWFD07LRR/EWFD08LRR. The cards below identify robot-mounted parts and Ultra dock parts separately.

Check the variant: S8 and S8+ are different configurations, and S8 Max Ultra and S8 MaxV Ultra are separate models. Do not assume their rollers, filters, mop parts or dock accessories fit the S8 Pro Ultra. The disposable bags and small high-speed cleaning brushes below are for its Empty Wash Fill Dock.

Roborock S8 Pro Ultra replacement filters

Two white washable robot filters in the selected Filter-A option.

View replacement filters on Amazon ↗

Fit: The Roborock Amazon listing explicitly names the S8 Pro Ultra in its compatible-model list.

Replace when: Roborock recommends replacing the washable robot filter every 6–12 months, or sooner if it is damaged or remains clogged after cleaning.

Before buying: This is the air filter in the robot dustbin, not the separate water filter in the dock. Select the two-filter white Filter-A option. After rinsing, let the filter air-dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling it.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

S8 Pro Ultra vs. S8 and S8+
S8 Pro Ultra is a distinct S8-series configuration with the Empty Wash Fill Dock and VibraRise 2.0. Check each component separately; the S8 Pro Ultra dual main-brush assembly is not the single full-width roller used by earlier Roborock models.
S8 Pro Ultra vs. S8 Max Ultra and S8 MaxV Ultra
These are separate robot models. A listing naming S8 Pro Ultra can support a specific shared consumable, such as the black side brushes or dock brush, but does not establish compatibility for filters, rollers or mop parts across all S8 models.
Robot filter vs. dock water filter
The washable white filter sits in the robot dustbin. The dock's water filter is a separate part that the manual says to remove and rinse as needed; it does not give a scheduled replacement interval.
Robot rollers vs. dock cleaning brush
The two main rollers underneath the robot pick up floor debris. The smaller high-speed brush in the Empty Wash Fill Dock cleans the mop in the washing tray. They are different parts.
S8 Pro Ultra dock bags
The listed six-pack is a 2.5 L disposable dust-bag pack that names S8 Pro Ultra. Confirm your dock model is EWFD07LRR or EWFD08LRR; a bag listing alone does not establish compatibility with another station.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock S8 Pro Ultra maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Roborock S8 Pro Ultra cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
Washable robot-bin filterEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Dual robot main brushesEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Robot side brushMonthlyEvery 3–6 months
VibraRise 2.0 mop clothAfter each useEvery 3–6 months
Dock high-speed cleaning brushAs neededEvery 6–12 months
Dock disposable dust bagDisposableWhen full
Dock water filterAs neededNo scheduled replacement interval in the manual

Rinse the robot's washable filter with clean water and leave it to dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling. Clear hair from both main-brush ends during routine cleaning. Keep a disposable bag installed when the dock auto-empties; rinse its separate water filter and clean the dock brush as needed.

Before you order

Which replacement filter fits the Roborock S8 Pro Ultra?

The linked original Roborock two-pack explicitly lists S8 Pro Ultra. Choose the white Filter-A option. It is the robot-bin air filter, not the dock water filter.

Does the S8 Pro Ultra use one main brush or two?

It uses two main rollers as a set. The linked third-party listing has a selected S8 option and explicitly names S8 Pro Ultra; compare the brush ends before ordering.

Which dust bags fit the Roborock S8 Pro Ultra dock?

The linked original Roborock six-pack is listed as 2.5 L bags and explicitly names S8 Pro Ultra. Confirm the dock is EWFD07LRR or EWFD08LRR and install a bag before auto-emptying.

How often should I replace Roborock S8 Pro Ultra filters, brushes and mop cloths?

Roborock recommends replacing the robot filter, main brushes and dock high-speed brush every 6–12 months, and the side brush and mop cloth every 3–6 months. Clean the filter and main brushes every two weeks, the side brush monthly and the mop cloth after each use. Replace damaged parts sooner.

Are the Roborock S8 Pro Ultra replacement parts on this page genuine?

The filter, side brushes, dock bags and dock cleaning brushes are Roborock-branded listings sold by Roborock Technology Co. Ltd when checked. The dual main-brush set is PELLYDA and the mop pads are KGC, both third-party listings. We have not physically fit-tested third-party parts.

Can I buy the original S8 Pro Ultra robot from Amazon?

The linked Amazon listing matched the S8 Pro Ultra robot-and-dock bundle, but showed the item as currently unavailable on October 7, 2026. Check the listing for a current offer; availability can change.
